crossRefs.note: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;
of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

translations.web: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
translations.bsb: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.
translations.kjv: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
translations.asv: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
